options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the viewer (region or dialog).

options.name: images
options.description: One or more images { src, alt, decorative?, caption?, thumbnail?, width?, height?, downloadName? }.

options.name: mode
options.description: inline renders into the host; lightbox renders a modal dialog opened with open().

options.name: aspectRatios
options.description: Crop presets { label, value: width / height | null }.

options.name: cropType
options.description: Blob type of the crop output.

options.name: cropQuality
options.description: Quality from 0 to 1 for JPEG and WebP output.

options.name: crossOrigin
options.description: CORS mode of the image request; needed to crop cross-origin images.

options.name: wheelZoom
options.description: When the wheel zooms: auto is Ctrl (or a pinch gesture) inline and always in the lightbox.

options.name: zoomStep
options.description: Zoom factor of one step, 1.05 to 4.

options.name: minZoom
options.description: Smallest zoom, 0.01 to 1 (fit may go lower for very large images).

options.name: showThumbnails
options.description: Show the thumbnail strip for two or more images.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the counter, zoom level, and messages.

properties.name: fitted
properties.description: Whether the image is fitted to the view.

properties.name: cropRect
properties.description: Crop rectangle in natural pixels of the rotated image.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Lightbox: whether the dialog is open (inline: always true).

methods.name: open
methods.description: Lightbox: open the dialog (optionally at an image). Inline: show that image.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show an image (clamped), fitted and unrotated.

methods.name: setZoom
methods.description: Set the zoom, clamped to the zoom range.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Fit the image to the view.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotate by a multiple of 90 degrees (default 90, clockwise).

methods.name: startCrop
methods.description: Enter crop mode with an aspect ratio (default: the first preset).

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crop to the crop rectangle; resolves with the canvas and Blob and emits aui-crop.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (mode is create-only).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove rendering, buttons, and listeners.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The shown image changed: { index, image }.

events.name: aui-rotate
events.description: The image was rotated: { rotation, index }.

events.name: aui-crop
events.description: A crop was applied: { blob, canvas, rect, rotation, index, image }.

events.name: aui-error
events.description: An image failed to load, or a crop was refused (tainted canvas): { index, image, reason, message }.

cssClasses.name: aui-image-viewer
cssClasses.description: The viewer (host inline, dialog in the lightbox).

cssClasses.name: aui-image-viewer-host
cssClasses.description: Host of a lightbox viewer (left empty).

cssClasses.name: aui-image-viewer__tool--<name>
cssClasses.description: One tool: previous, next, zoomOut, zoomIn, fitToggle, rotateLeft, rotateRight, crop, download, close.

cssClasses.name: aui-image-viewer__stage
cssClasses.description: Focusable image area; height from --aui-image-viewer-height inline.
